identifier_definitions.B-01: Survey method: B-01 tells the agent what to read and what to record.

notice: Rendered from the command line. Its read-back was not recorded in the survey's record, so the Publication integrity figures on the overview describe an earlier publication.

pages.hint: What the codebase is, and where the survey stands.
pages.label: Overview
pages.title: Project overview
pages.use_when: you arrive, or want the current counts.

pages.hint: Runtime shape, recorded edges, and boundaries, read as one connected system.
pages.label: Architecture
pages.title: Architecture at a glance
pages.use_when: you want the overall shape before reading any one part.

pages.hint: Every region, grouped by layer, with the scope recorded for it.
pages.label: Subsystems
pages.title: Subsystem map
pages.use_when: you are looking for the part of the code that does something.

pages.hint: One row per ledger file with owners, standing, and open defects.
pages.label: Files
pages.title: Files
pages.use_when: you want to know whether a particular file was read.

pages.hint: The recorded edge of the map, each gap counted over the unit it occupies.
pages.label: Not yet surveyed
pages.title: Not yet surveyed
pages.use_when: you want to know what the survey has not covered.

pages.hint: Shared objects and ordering assumptions where independently understandable subsystems meet.
pages.label: System boundaries
pages.title: System boundaries
pages.use_when: you are changing something two subsystems share.

pages.hint: The project's own names, with the meanings Amanuensis observed in context.
pages.label: Codebase glossary
pages.title: Codebase glossary
pages.use_when: a project-specific name is unfamiliar.

pages.hint: Defects open or awaiting verification at the checked revision.
pages.label: Open findings
pages.title: Open findings
pages.use_when: you want the defects still open.

pages.hint: Where credible records disagree or the evidence does not discriminate between them.
pages.label: Disagreements
pages.title: Records that disagree
pages.use_when: you want to know where the record contradicts itself.

pages.hint: Questions the survey could not settle, with the assumption used to keep moving.
pages.label: Decisions needed
pages.title: Decisions needed
pages.use_when: you want to know what the agent needs from you.

pages.hint: Open observations that are not yet findings.
pages.label: Leads
pages.title: Leads
pages.use_when: you want things noticed but not yet confirmed.

pages.hint: Examined files the repository has changed under, and scoped files that changed before anyone read them.
pages.label: Stale knowledge
pages.title: Stale knowledge
pages.use_when: you want to know what may be out of date since the code changed.

pages.hint: Where unresolved work and unread territory concentrate, as separate measures.
pages.label: Hot spots
pages.title: Hot spots
pages.use_when: you want to know where open work concentrates.

pages.hint: Verified, ruled out, and accepted, each with the basis its resolution rests on.
pages.label: Resolved findings
pages.title: Resolved findings
pages.use_when: you want to know what was fixed or ruled out, and on what basis.

pages.hint: The append-only account of how records reached their state.
pages.label: Resolution history
pages.title: Resolution history
pages.use_when: you want to know how a record reached its state.

pages.hint: Questions that were answered or dismissed, and leads that were closed.
pages.label: Resolved leads and questions
pages.title: Resolved leads and questions
pages.use_when: you want to know how a question was answered.

pages.hint: What ran, when, and what it produced.
pages.label: Sessions and publications
pages.title: Sessions and publications
pages.use_when: you want to know when the survey ran.

pages.hint: Resolved disagreements and the evidence that settled them.
pages.label: Conflicting evidence
pages.title: Conflicting evidence
pages.use_when: you want to see how a disagreement was settled.

pages.hint: What each page is for, the terms the site uses, and how a survey works.
pages.label: Reader's guide
pages.title: How to read this survey
pages.use_when: a word, an ID or a page is unfamiliar.

pages.hint: Which failure modes were tested where, and the disposition each one reached.
pages.label: Review coverage
pages.title: Review coverage
pages.use_when: you want to know which defect kinds were checked where.

pages.hint: The concern set and its provenance.
pages.label: Review checklist
pages.title: Calibrated review checklist
pages.use_when: you want the list of defect kinds and where it came from.

pages.hint: Index of evidence matrices and their outcomes.
pages.label: Competing explanations
pages.title: Competing explanations
pages.use_when: you want to see how a symptom's cause was weighed.

pages.hint: The repository boundary and initial decomposition that established this conspectus.
pages.label: Onboarding record
pages.title: Onboarding record
pages.use_when: you want the first pass's decisions about scope and split.

pages.hint: A dated reading path recorded by an earlier session; it is survey history, not a current index.
pages.label: Where to begin
pages.title: Where to begin
pages.use_when: you want the reading path an earlier session wrote.
